Name: Palm Beach
Author: rafafariasc
Description:
Literally just adds a few palm trees to the beach.  This is my first attempt at mod making so I thought I'd start small, sharing while I learn before taking on more ambitious projects.  I always felt that the beach seemed a little bare, so I added a few palms to give the beach a more tropical vibe.  If added to an existing save game, the trees will take a few days to grow.

May eventually add seasonal changes for the palms, if I can figure out how to add them only to the beach and not the desert.

UPDATE: version 1.0.1 adds coconuts spawning on the beach (except in winter).

Downloads.Description:
Extract to mods folder. Should be compatible with anything that doesn't modify the beach map or beach festival maps.
Choose this file if you want the palm trees only.
